market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: On March 20, 2026 the Treasury issued a sanctions license waiving restrictions on the purchase of ~140M barrels of Iranian crude already at sea, framed by Treasury Sec. Bessent as a deliberate easing (CBS, NBC, WaPo, CFR). That was an officially announced reduction by an authorized U.S. representative — fits the resolution criteria literally. However, Polymarket may interpret 'sanction relief' as a broader/structural removal rather than a temporary, narrow waiver; ongoing nuclear negotiations (Axios, CNN) also point toward a possible MOU before May 31 that would unambiguously qualify. Net: more likely Yes than No on a strict read, but interpretation risk is real.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the existing March 30-day waiver and any May MOU count as 'sanction relief' under the market's interpretation.
